text:
laura: Hey team, Acme reported production incidents: browser JS SDK streaming sessions suddenly drop with partial output, then a wave of reconnects that overwhelm the endpoint and produce 502/500 spikes. Customer says this started after a recent auth token rotation change.

support-bot: Ticket #INC-8421 created and linked to AcmeCorp. Assigned: ben (eng oncall). :white_check_mark:

ben: Thanks — can you paste the client's minimal repro + server logs? Do they use EventSource or fetch/ReadableStream?

laura: They use our JS streaming SDK (fetch + ReadableStream iterator). Minimal repro steps from customer:
1) Start 200 browser tabs with a streaming request to /v1/streams.
2) After ~30s the server rotates short-lived auth (custom token refresh).
3) ~40% of clients get an AbortError midstream, return partial JSON object, then immediately start a new connection with no backoff.
4) New connections spike and backend returns 502/500; some streams never receive the final "done" event.

laura: Customer provided this client snippet:
```js
const res = await fetch('/v1/streams', { method: 'POST', headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }, body: JSON.stringify({prompt}) });
const reader = res.body.getReader();
// iterate and yield chunks to app-level iterator
while(true){ const {done, value} = await reader.read(); if(done) break; yield decoder.decode(value); }
```

michael: Interesting. Logs from our side around the incident: (excerpt)
```
2024-11-08T18:23:41Z svc-stream[pool-17] INFO conn=712 auth=rotated user=acme req=/v1/streams 200 start seq=1
2024-11-08T18:23:44Z svc-stream[pool-17] ERROR conn=734 read=AbortError user=acme partial_frame_id=abc123
2024-11-08T18:23:44Z svc-proxy[edge-1] WARN backend=svc-stream status=502 active_conn=198 backlog=63
2024-11-08T18:23:45Z svc-stream[pool-17] ERROR accept=EMFILE user=acme: too many open files
```

ben: Looks like two correlated problems: (A) client retries immediately on AbortError creating thundering reconnects, (B) server-side file descriptor exhaustion/backlog from many concurrent reconnects.

ben: Repro plan: try to reproduce locally with a sim that rotates tokens midstream and spawns 300 clients which reconnect immediately on error. If we can repro, we can validate mitigations (client backoff + server accept queue tuning + short grace period for stale tokens).

sre-jess: FYI we already have limits on accept queue but not enough. Short-term mitigations: increase accept queue sockets, add token-grace window (30s) on auth microgateway, and add circuit-breaker to reject rapid reconnects per IP/customer.

michael: Also noticed the JS SDK's iterator doesn't surface a recovery hook — many apps just call iterator.next() and on exception they re-open immediately. We should provide built-in automatic exponential backoff with jitter when iterator ends with a transient error (401/5xx/AbortError).

laura: Customer wants either a workaround or fix. Suggested workaround they tried: add a 500ms setTimeout before retry, which reduced spike but still hit 502 during heavy load.

ben: For prioritization: short-term — doc + recommend client backoff pattern and enable token grace on gateway. Medium — patch JS SDK to include opt-in auto-retry/backoff for transient streaming errors. Long — server-side rate-limiting/circuit-breaker improvements.

michael: Quick repro script I ran locally (node):
```js
// spawn N clients that reconnect on error with no backoff
for(let i=0;i<300;i++){ startClient(i); }
async function startClient(i){ try{ await consumeStream(); }catch(e){ // immediate restart -> reproduces thundering herd
 startClient(i); } }
```

ben: Can someone try a controlled run that adds exponential backoff on client restart and measure backend QPS/FDs? If backoff reduces peak concurrency and errors we'll push a hotfix to SDK and a KB article.

laura: I'll pass new mitigation steps to Acme: (1) add backoff + jitter in their reconnect path, (2) upgrade to latest edge config with 30s token grace (we can enable for them temporarily), (3) enable per-customer connection throttling.

sre-jess: Also collecting kernel logs and ulimit settings from the customer's host/network egress. Could be that browser tabs are on a single machine and ephemeral ports are exhausted leading to weird ECONNRESET behavior.

ben: Action items: @michael reproduce and open PR for SDK auto-backoff + add opt-out flag; @sre-jess toggle token-grace on Acme env and raise accept queue; @laura share KB + mitigation steps with customer. I'll own the incident ticket.

laura: Thanks — updating Acme now. :thumbsup:

support-bot: INC-8421 updated: assignee=ben, status=investigating, priority=high

michael: quick note — when reproducing, watch for partial JSON frames missing trailing comma/closing brace (likely due to midstream abort + immediate reconnect causing duplicate partial writes). We'll add a framing sanity check on server to avoid accepting partial final frames as complete.

laura: copying this to the customer thread and including the small server log excerpt and recommended client snippet. Will follow up with results.
